# evaluate

Evaluated records — what importing a plugin barrel produced, as data under
the barrel's module Merkle key. The mechanism is documented in the parent's
`CLAUDE.md` (Evaluation, Declaration-dependent barrels). It is a child of
`plugin-records` rather than part of its `core` barrel because a record
producer that only computes keys and stores records (the facet extraction
harness) would otherwise key every facet record on barrel-import's stubs and
the slot-declaration engine, which it never calls.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Evaluated records: what importing a plugin barrel produced (its definition, slots, contributions), serialized as data under the barrel's module Merkle key, so a build reads it without importing anything. Apart from plugin-records' core so a record producer that only makes keys and stores records (the facet harness) does not key on barrel-import's stubs and the slot-declaration engine.
